AccountBudget.description: AccountBudget configures the share of quotas the account may use.

scaleRates.description: ScaleRates also scales rate and concurrency limits by the share.

share.description:
Share of every quota limit Tapyr may use, when other consumers share
the same credentials. In (0, 1].

AccountSpec.description: AccountSpec is the specification of an Account.

labels.description: Labels added to every sample from this account.

secrets.description:
Secrets declared by the provider, as references to environment
variables or files.

targets.description:
Targets of a multi-target account (for example one entry per device).
Jobs run once per target.

tls.description: TLS settings for connections to the provider.

AppliesTo.description: AppliesTo restricts the requests a limit counts.

authRequests.description:
AuthRequests selects regular requests and token requests: include
(both), only (token requests only) or exclude (regular requests only).

endpoints.description:
Endpoints are globs on the templated path: * matches within one
segment, ** matches any number of segments.

requestsWithVar.description: RequestsWithVar counts only requests where this variable is set.

basic.description: Basic sends HTTP basic credentials (type basic).

header.description: Header sends a static value in a header (type header).

oauth2ClientCredentials.description:
OAuth2ClientCredentials obtains tokens with the OAuth 2.0 client
credentials grant (type oauth2_client_credentials).

plugin.description: Plugin delegates to a Go auth plugin (type plugin).

sessionLogin.description: SessionLogin posts credentials to obtain a session token (type session_login).

BasicAuthSecrets.description: BasicAuthSecrets are HTTP basic credentials read from secrets.

BudgetSettings.description: BudgetSettings configures the budget engine and the planner.

maxStretch.description:
MaxStretch caps the interval stretch factor applied to a priority
class before the planner moves to the next class.

replanInterval.description: ReplanInterval is the period of mid-window replanning.

replanOnProjection.description:
ReplanOnProjection replans at once when the consumption projected by
the current plan until the end of a quota window exceeds its remaining
budget, for example when another client starts spending the same
quota, instead of waiting for the next replanInterval.

retryReserve.description: RetryReserve is the share of every quota reserved for retries, from 0% to 50%.

CircuitBreakerSettings.description: CircuitBreakerSettings configures the per-account circuit breakers.

failureThreshold.description:
FailureThreshold is the number of consecutive transient failures that
opens the circuit.

maxCooldown.description: MaxCooldown caps the cooldown, which doubles on repeated openings.

defaultTimeout.description: DefaultTimeout of a request when the provider sets none.

jitter.description: Jitter spreads scheduled runs, from 0% to 50% of the interval.

maxConcurrentRequests.description: MaxConcurrentRequests bounds in-flight requests across all providers.

CursorPagination.description: CursorPagination passes a cursor extracted from each response.

cursor.description: Cursor is a CEL expression extracting the next cursor; empty or null stops.

header.description: Header carrying the cursor, instead of a query parameter.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

pageSizeParam.description: PageSizeParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

param.description: Param is the query parameter carrying the cursor.

DebugSettings.description: DebugSettings configures the live debug endpoint.

enabled.description: Enabled exposes the last raw responses (redacted) in the status API.

maxBodyBytes.description: MaxBodyBytes truncates the raw responses kept for debugging.

DocumentAccount.description: An instance of a provider with credentials, params, targets and labels.
DocumentAccount.title: Account

DocumentJob.description: What to collect for an account, from a template or inline.
DocumentJob.title: Job

DocumentJobTemplate.description: A reusable job definition shipped by a provider package.
DocumentJobTemplate.title: JobTemplate

DocumentProvider.description: An API family: base URL, auth, pagination, error semantics and rate limits.
DocumentProvider.title: Provider

DocumentScenario.description: A simulator scenario of a provider package (sim/scenarios/*.yaml).
DocumentScenario.title: Scenario

DocumentSimulation.description: The simulator of a provider package (sim/sim.yaml).
DocumentSimulation.title: Simulation

ErrorSemantics.description: ErrorSemantics declares how the provider signals errors.

Estimate.description: Estimate gives hints to the planner.

pagesPerRun.description: PagesPerRun is the expected number of pages per run.

ExpressionPagination.description: ExpressionPagination computes the next request with CEL.

next.description: Next is a CEL expression returning {query: {...}} for the next page, or null.

ExternalConsumption.description: ExternalConsumption consumes a quota at a steady rate.

limit.description: Limit is the name of a quota limit of the provider.

Extract.description: Extract maps responses to samples and inventory items.

filter.description: Filter is a CEL expression on item; false skips the item.

info.description: Info metrics (value 1, descriptive labels) produced per item.

inventory.description: Inventory items produced per item (role inventory or both).

items.description:
Items is a CEL expression returning the list of items of a page.
Default: response.body when it is a list.

partial.description: Partial emits the samples of a run even when a later page fails.

post.description: Post metrics computed once per run over all pages (responses).

ForEach.description: ForEach fans a job out over the inventory items of a parent job.

filter.description: Filter is a CEL expression on parent selecting a subset of items.

job.description: Job is the parent Job (same account), for inline jobs.

maxInstances.description: MaxInstances caps the fan-out, against runaway discovery.

template.description:
Template is the parent JobTemplate, instantiated implicitly for the
account when no job references it.

vars.description: Vars maps request variables to CEL expressions on parent.

HeaderAuth.description: HeaderAuth sends a static credential in a request header.

format.description:
Format of the header value; {value} is replaced by the value, for
example "Token {value}".

name.description: Name of the header, for example X-API-Key.

value.description: Value of the header, usually {secret: name}.

InfoMetric.description: InfoMetric produces an _info metric: value 1 and descriptive labels.

labels.description: Labels maps label names to CEL expressions returning strings.

name.description: Name of the metric, ending with _info.

skipIf.description: SkipIf is a CEL expression; true skips the sample.

Inventory.description: Inventory produces inventory items for child jobs.

fields.description: Fields maps field names to CEL expressions, available as parent.<field>.

key.description: Key is a CEL expression returning the unique key of an item.

ttl.description: TTL of cached items. Default: 3x the job's effective interval.

JobSpec.description: JobSpec is the specification of a Job.

estimate.description: Estimate gives hints to the planner before run history exists.

extract.description: Extract maps responses to samples and inventory items.

forEach.description: ForEach fans the job out over the inventory items of a parent.

interval.description:
Interval is the desired interval; the planner may stretch it.
Defaults to the template's defaultInterval.

labels.description: Labels added to every sample of the job.

outputs.description: Outputs receiving the job's samples. Default: all outputs.

priority.description: Priority of the job. Defaults to the template's defaultPriority, else normal.

role.description: Role of the job: inventory items, metrics, or both.

staleAfter.description:
StaleAfter removes series of failing runs after this delay. Default:
3x the effective interval.

JobTemplateSpec.description: JobTemplateSpec is the specification of a JobTemplate.

defaultInterval.description: DefaultInterval is the desired interval of jobs using the template.

defaultPriority.description: DefaultPriority of jobs using the template.

estimate.description: Estimate gives hints to the planner before run history exists.

extract.description: Extract maps responses to samples and inventory items.

forEach.description: ForEach fans the job out over the inventory items of a parent.

role.description: Role of the job: inventory items, metrics, or both.

Limit.description: Limit is a constraint of the provider API, enforced by the budget engine for every request (see docs/spec/04-budget-engine.md).

appliesTo.description: AppliesTo restricts the requests the limit counts.

burst.description:
Burst is the bucket capacity of a rate limit. Defaults to the rate per
second, minimum 1.

description.description: Description is free text for humans, ideally with the source of the limit.

initialMax.description:
InitialMax is the conservative quota maximum used with max: auto
until the first limit header is observed.

kind.description: Kind of limit: rate (token bucket), concurrency or quota (window).

max.description:
Max is the maximum of a concurrency limit, or of a quota per window.
A quota may use "auto" to learn it from response headers.

name.description: Name of the limit, unique within the provider.

rate.description: Rate is the refill rate of a rate limit, for example 10/s.

scope.description: Scope partitions the limit (one counter per scope key).

source.description:
Source of the limit. Optional, and required on every limit by
tapyr provider lint --catalog.

sync.description: Sync reads quota state from response headers.

window.description: Window of a quota: a calendar period or a rolling duration.

LimitSource.description: LimitSource says where a limit comes from.

date.description:
Date the source was checked or the measurement made, YYYY-MM-DD or
YYYY-MM.

kind.description:
Kind is vendor-docs (the vendor documentation, with its url), measured
(against the real API, with its date) or assumed (nothing documented).

url.description: URL of the vendor documentation, or of the notes of a measurement.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

pageSizeParam.description: PageSizeParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

rel.description: Rel is the link relation of the next page.

level.description: Level: debug, info, warn or error.

LoginRequest.description: LoginRequest is the request that opens a session.

body.description: Body is a JSON object; values are literals, secrets or CEL expressions.

headers.description: Headers added to the login request.

path.description: Path of the login endpoint, relative to the base URL.

LogoutRequest.description: LogoutRequest is the request that closes a session, sent with the token applied.

path.description: Path of the logout endpoint, relative to the base URL.

labelConflict.description:
LabelConflict resolves labels set both by the mapping and by
account, target or job labels: override (job > target > account >
mapping) or error.

maxCost.description: MaxCost is the CEL cost limit per expression evaluation.

maxItemsPerRun.description: MaxItemsPerRun caps the items extracted by a run.

maxSamplesPerRun.description: MaxSamplesPerRun caps the samples produced by a run.

Metric.description: Metric maps items to samples of one metric.

accumulate.description:
Accumulate sums successive window values into a persisted counter
(type counter only).

labels.description: Labels maps label names to CEL expressions returning strings.

name.description: Name of the metric (Prometheus naming rules).

skipIf.description: SkipIf is a CEL expression; true skips the sample.

timestamp.description: Timestamp is a CEL expression returning the source timestamp.

unit.description: Unit of the metric, preferably a Prometheus base unit.

value.description: Value is a CEL expression returning a number or a bool.

windowField.description:
WindowField is a CEL expression identifying the window of a value,
used by accumulate to avoid counting a window twice.

OAuth2ClientCredentials.description: OAuth2ClientCredentials configures the OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant.

audience.description: Audience requested, when the server requires one.

authStyle.description:
AuthStyle sends the client credentials in the Authorization header or
in the request body.

extraParams.description: ExtraParams added to the token request.

tokenURL.description: TokenURL of the authorization server. Template.

headers.description: Headers added to every request; values are literals or secrets.

resourceAttributes.description: ResourceAttributes added to the OTLP resource.

description.description: Description is free text for humans.

name.description: Name of the document, unique per kind.

OffsetPagination.description: OffsetPagination requests pages by item offset.

limitParam.description: LimitParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

offsetParam.description: OffsetParam is the query parameter carrying the offset.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

stop.description: Stop is a CEL expression; pagination stops when it returns true.

total.description: Total is a CEL expression returning the total number of items.

OutputSpec.description: OutputSpec is the specification of an Output.

externalLabels.description: ExternalLabels added to every sample sent through this output.

processing.description:
Processing is an ordered list of rules applied to the samples of the
jobs sent to this output only, with the semantics of Prometheus
metric_relabel_configs (ADR 0012). Self-metrics are never processed.

prometheus.description: Prometheus pull exposition on /metrics (type prometheus, at most one).

queue.description: Queue of a push output (not allowed for prometheus).

remoteWrite.description: RemoteWrite pushes with Prometheus remote write 1.0 (type remote_write).

PagePagination.description: PagePagination requests pages by page number.

pageParam.description: PageParam is the query parameter carrying the page number.

pageSize.description: PageSize is the number of items per page.

sizeParam.description: SizeParam is the query parameter carrying the page size.

start.description: Start is the first page number.

stop.description: Stop is a CEL expression; pagination stops when it returns true.

total.description: Total is a CEL expression returning the total number of items.

Pagination.description: Pagination configures how successive pages are requested.

expression.description: Expression pagination computed by CEL (type expression).

linkHeader.description: LinkHeader pagination following RFC 8288 Link headers (type link_header).

maxPages.description: MaxPages is a hard safety cap on pages per run.

ParamSpec.description: ParamSpec declares a param or a secret that accounts provide.

description.description: Description is free text for humans.

name.description: Name of the param or secret.

required.description:
Required makes the param or secret mandatory for every account (or
every target of a multi-target account).

PluginAuth.description: PluginAuth selects a Go auth plugin, for flows that cannot be expressed declaratively.

config.description: Config is passed to the plugin, which validates it.

name.description: Name of the plugin, as registered in internal/auth/plugins.

ProcessingRule.description: ProcessingRule keeps or drops samples, or labels, of an output.

action.description:
Action: keep or drop the samples whose joined sourceLabels match
regex; labelkeep or labeldrop the labels whose name matches regex.

regex.description:
Regex is an RE2 regular expression, fully anchored. keep and drop
default to (.*); labelkeep and labeldrop require it.

separator.description: Separator joins the values of sourceLabels (keep and drop).

sourceLabels.description:
SourceLabels are the labels whose values are joined and matched
(keep and drop, required); __name__ is the metric name, a missing
label the empty string.

exposeTimestamps.description:
ExposeTimestamps adds sample timestamps to the exposition. Off by
default, as recommended by Prometheus.

categories.description:
Categories of the provider, from providers/categories.yaml, the main
one first.

description.description: Description is free text for humans.

displayName.description:
DisplayName is the name of the provider in the catalog, for example
"Cisco Meraki Dashboard". Like categories, maintainers, tier and
validation, it is optional, and required by tapyr provider lint
--catalog (ADR 0011).

docs.description: Docs links to the vendor API documentation.

maintainers.description:
Maintainers are the GitHub handles, without @, of the people who answer
for the package.

name.description: Name of the provider, unique across built-in and user packages.

tier.description:
Tier says who maintains the package: official (the Tapyr maintainers)
or community (the maintainers listed).

validation.description: Validation says how the package was last tested.

version.description:
Version of the provider package (semver). Breaking changes to metric
names or labels bump the major version.

ProviderSpec.description: ProviderSpec is the specification of a Provider.

auth.description: Auth applied to every request. Defaults to type none.

baseURL.description:
BaseURL of the API. Template evaluated per account and target, for
example {{ .params.baseURL | default "https://api.example.com/v1" }}.

errors.description:
Errors declares how the API signals rate limiting, authentication
failures and retryable errors.

limits.description: Limits declares every rate limit, concurrency limit and quota of the API.

pagination.description: Pagination used by job templates that do not override it.

params.description: Params an Account may or must provide.

redirects.description:
Redirects lists the other hosts a response may redirect requests to.
Redirects to another host are not followed otherwise: credentials
only go to the base URL and to these hosts.

secrets.description: Secrets an Account may or must provide.

Queue.description: Queue is the bounded in-memory queue of a push output.

capacity.description:
Capacity in samples; the oldest samples are dropped (with accounting)
when full.

flushInterval.description: FlushInterval sends a partial batch after this delay.

maxBatch.description: MaxBatch is the maximum number of samples per request.

QuotaSync.description: QuotaSync names the response headers carrying quota state.

resetHeader.description: ResetHeader carries the reset time (epoch seconds or delta seconds).

RateLimitedErrors.description: RateLimitedErrors matches rate-limited responses and configures penalties.

defaultPenalty.description:
DefaultPenalty applies when no Retry-After header is present. It grows
exponentially on consecutive rate-limited responses, up to 10 minutes.

penalize.description: Penalize the narrowest applicable scope, or all applicable scopes.

retryAfterHeader.description: RetryAfterHeader carries the penalty in seconds or as an HTTP date.

Redirects.description: Redirects allows HTTP redirects to other hosts.

hosts.description:
Hosts the requests may be redirected to: a host name, or "*." and a
domain for every host under it (for example "*.meraki.com").

headers.description: Headers added to every request; values are literals or secrets.

url.description: URL of the remote write endpoint.

Request.description: Request describes the HTTP request of a job.

body.description:
Body is a JSON object for POST queries; values are literals, secrets or
CEL expressions.

headers.description: Headers merged over the provider defaults (the job wins).

method.description: Method of the request. POST is allowed only for read-only queries.

path.description:
Path relative to the base URL, with {var} placeholders resolved from
discovery variables, target params and account params.

query.description: Query parameters; values are literals, secrets or CEL expressions.

readOnly.description: ReadOnly must be true for POST requests: Tapyr never writes to providers.

timeout.description: Timeout of a single request. Defaults to the provider default.

RequestDefaults.description: RequestDefaults are applied to every request of the provider.

headers.description: Headers added to every request. Values are templates.

timeout.description: Timeout of a single request. Defaults to settings.collection.defaultTimeout.

RetrySettings.description: RetrySettings configures retries with exponential backoff and full jitter.

maxAttempts.description: MaxAttempts per request, including the first attempt.

multiplier.description: Multiplier of the backoff between attempts.

ratio.description: Ratio of the matching requests that fail (0 to 1).

routes.description:
Routes are globs on the route paths (* within a segment, ** across
segments). Empty means every route.

ScenarioLatency.description: ScenarioLatency is a log-normal response delay given by two quantiles.

p99.description: P99 is the 99th percentile, at least P50.

max.description: Max of the quota per window.

ScenarioSpec.description: ScenarioSpec is the specification of a Scenario.

ScenarioStep.description: ScenarioStep applies from at until at + for (or until the end), in simulated time since the simulator start.

at.description: At is the start of the step.

errors.description: Errors answers a ratio of the requests to matching routes with a status.

externalConsumption.description: ExternalConsumption simulates another client consuming a quota.

fixtures.description:
Fixtures replaces the fixture of routes, by route path, to simulate
inventory changes. Files are relative to the sim/ directory and take
the {var} placeholders of the route.

for.description: For is the duration of the step; empty means until the end.

latency.description: Latency delays the responses (log-normal, in simulated time).

limits.description: Limits overrides the max of named quota limits.

outage.description: Outage closes connections without a response.

tokenExpiry.description:
TokenExpiry invalidates, when the step starts, the tokens issued
before it.

by.description:
By lists the scope dimensions: instance, provider, account, target,
credential, endpoint or var:<name>. Empty means instance.

SecretRef.description: A secret read from an environment variable ({env: NAME}) or a file ({file: /path}).

env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the secret.

file.description: Path of a file holding the secret, relative to the declaring file.

interval.description: Interval between two pushes of the self-metrics to Outputs.

outputs.description: Outputs that also receive the self-metrics (always served on /metrics/self).

ServerBasicAuth.description: ServerBasicAuth protects the server with HTTP basic authentication.

debug.description: Debug is the live debug endpoint exposing raw responses.

tls.description:
TLS serves HTTPS with the given certificate. A reverse proxy is the
recommended way to terminate TLS.

ui.description: UI is the embedded read-only web UI.

ServerTLS.description: ServerTLS holds the server certificate files, relative to the declaring file.

certFile.description: CertFile is the PEM certificate chain.

keyFile.description: KeyFile is the PEM private key.

SessionLogin.description: SessionLogin posts credentials to a login endpoint and applies the returned token to subsequent requests.

apply.description: Apply describes how the token is attached to requests.

expiresIn.description: ExpiresIn is a CEL expression returning the token lifetime as a duration.

logout.description:
Logout closes a session when its token is replaced and when Tapyr
stops, for APIs that keep sessions open until they are closed.

perTarget.description: PerTarget keeps one session per target of a multi-target account.

refreshBefore.description: RefreshBefore renews the session this long before it expires.

token.description: Token is a CEL expression extracting the token from the login response.

SettingsSpec.description: SettingsSpec is the specification of Settings.

budget.description: Budget configures the budget engine and the planner.

circuitBreaker.description: CircuitBreaker configures the per-account circuit breakers.

log.description: Log configures logging. Flags and environment variables win.

providerPaths.description:
ProviderPaths lists directories of user provider packages, in
addition to the built-in packages.

retry.description: Retry configures retries of transient errors.

server.description: Server is the HTTP server (metrics, health, status API, UI).

state.description: State is the persistent state store.

SimulationAuth.description: SimulationAuth configures the credentials accepted by the simulator.

accept.description: Accept lists the accepted credentials. They are fake values by design.

loginResponse.description:
LoginResponse is a JSON fixture answered by the login endpoint, relative
to the sim/ directory; {token} and {expiresIn} (seconds) are replaced.
Default: {"token": "{token}", "expiresIn": {expiresIn}}.

tokenLifetime.description:
TokenLifetime of the tokens issued by the token and login endpoints,
in simulated time.

SimulationBasicCredential.description: SimulationBasicCredential is a username and password pair.

SimulationCredentials.description: SimulationCredentials are accepted credentials per auth type.

basic.description: Basic credentials accepted with auth type basic.

bearer.description: Bearer tokens accepted with auth type bearer.

clients.description:
Clients accepted by the token endpoint with auth type
oauth2_client_credentials.

header.description:
Header values accepted with auth type header, before the format of
the provider auth is applied.

logins.description:
Logins accepted by the login endpoint with auth type session_login:
the login body must carry both values.

plugin.description:
Plugin holds the credentials accepted by the simulator side of an
auth plugin (type plugin), read by the plugin.

SimulationInventory.description: SimulationInventory is a synthetic inventory: sets of items, each item under a parent item of another set.

seed.description:
Seed of the generated values. The same seed gives the same items and
the same dynamics.

sets.description: Sets of items, generated in order: a parent set comes first.

SimulationResponse.description: SimulationResponse is the response of a route.

itemsField.description:
ItemsField is the dotted path of the list a paginated route serves
page by page, inside an envelope; empty for a top-level array.

template.description:
Template is a Go text/template fixture rendering JSON, relative to
the sim/ directory (see docs/spec/08-simulator.md for its data and
helpers). Exactly one of file and template is set.

SimulationRoute.description: SimulationRoute is an endpoint of the simulator.

pagination.description:
Pagination serves the fixture items page by page. Its parameters come
from the job templates requesting this path, or from the provider.

path.description: Path of the route, relative to basePath, with {var} segments.

SimulationSet.description: SimulationSet is a set of generated items.

count.description: Count of items (per parent item when Parent is set).

name.description: Name of the set, used by the template helpers.

parent.description: Parent set: count items are generated under each of its items.

SimulationSpec.description: SimulationSpec is the specification of a Simulation.

auth.description:
Auth lists the credentials the simulator accepts. The way they are
checked follows the provider auth type.

basePath.description:
BasePath is the path prefix of the API (the path part of the provider
base URL). Routes are relative to it.

headers.description:
Headers added to every response, computed from the limit state:
"limit:<name>.max", "limit:<name>.remaining" or "limit:<name>.reset"
(seconds until the window resets).

inventory.description: Inventory generates synthetic items for templated fixtures.

portOffset.description:
PortOffset is the port of the simulator in tapyr sim --all, as an
offset from --listen-base, so that adding a package does not move the
others. Simulators without one take the ports after the largest
declared offset, in provider name order.

routes.description: Routes served by the simulator. Unknown routes return 404.

path.description:
Path of the SQLite database, relative to the declaring file. The
built-in default is relative to the working directory.

StatusMatcher.description: StatusMatcher matches responses by HTTP status code.

env.description: Name of an environment variable holding the secret.

file.description: Path of a file holding the secret, relative to the declaring file.

TLSClient.description: TLSClient configures TLS towards the provider.

caFile.description: CAFile is a PEM bundle of trusted CAs, relative to the declaring file.

insecureSkipVerify.description: InsecureSkipVerify disables certificate verification. Logged loudly.

Target.description: Target is one endpoint of a multi-target account.

labels.description: Labels added to every sample from this target.

name.description: Name of the target, unique within the account.

Template.description: Go text/template evaluated per account and target.

TokenApply.description: TokenApply attaches a session token to requests, as a header or a cookie.

format.description: Format of the header value; {token} is replaced by the token.

Validation.description: Validation records the last validation of a provider package.

date.description:
Date of the validation, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM. Required by
tapyr provider lint --catalog with status real-platform.

notes.description: Notes is free text: what was covered, what the package was built from.

platformVersion.description:
PlatformVersion is the version of the API, platform or firmware
validated against, for example "RutOS 07.24.5". Required by
tapyr provider lint --catalog with status real-platform.

status.description:
Status is simulator (tested against its simulator only) or
real-platform (run against the real API).

Value.description: A literal string, {secret: name} or {expr: cel}.

secret.description: Name of a secret declared by the provider and supplied by the account.

Window.description: Window is the window of a quota: exactly one of period or rolling.

monthDay.description:
MonthDay is the day of month windows reset (1 to 31; the last day of
shorter months).

period.description: Period of a fixed calendar window.

resetAt.description:
ResetAt is the time of day (HH:MM, 24h) at which day, week and month
windows reset.

rolling.description: Rolling is the duration of a rolling window (1-minute precision).

weekStart.description: WeekStart is the first day of week windows.

description: Any Tapyr tapyr/v1alpha1 configuration document, dispatched on kind.
title: Tapyr configuration document
